reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept the clause [ORGANIZATION IS] INDEXED in each of its spellings (ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED, ORGANIZATION INDEXED, bare INDEXED), give the file indexed organization in every access mode, and refuse a malformed clause and the later editions' LINE/RECORD SEQUENTIAL spellings; the witnesses exercise only the LINE/RECORD refusals and the runtime permanence, not the three spellings of the INDEXED arm.

edition-consulted.switches: LINE SEQUENTIAL and the written RECORD of RECORD SEQUENTIAL are refused below 2023 (COBOL0900, constructs file-organization-line-sequential-2023 / -record-sequential-2023); the INDEXED alternative is not checked, same code at every edition
DialectBehaviors.IsActive(IndexedReadPreviousAfterOpenAtEnd / IndexedDuplicateKeyStatusSequentialOnly, Edition) on READ PREVIOUS and duplicate-key status; neither reached by this format rule

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel|IsActive in FileControlBinder.cs, IndexedConnector.cs, KeyedStore.cs and VersionConformancePass VisitOrganizationClause
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the INDEXED arm; yes for its sibling alternatives: LINE SEQUENTIAL and RECORD SEQUENTIAL compile at 2023 and are refused at 85
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the three spellings of the INDEXED clause and the access modes are not exercised by the witnesses (only by pb1098's ORGANIZATION INDEXED spelling)

reader.notes: The grammar's (ORGANIZATION IS?)? INDEXED is exactly the 1985 format (IS not underlined, so optional). The edition gate exists only for the 2023 LINE/RECORD alternatives; the INDEXED arm is edition-invariant and right at 85. The COBOL5506 for a misspelling lists LINE and RECORD as expected words at 85, a cosmetic diagnostic point, not a verdict.

refuter.evidence: At --std 85 (probes in E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-001/): oi_a.cob bare INDEXED written BEFORE ASSIGN, oi_b.cob ORGANIZATION INDEXED written LAST after RECORD KEY/ACCESS/FILE STATUS, oi_f.cob ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED with ASSIGN (no TO), ACCESS (no MODE), RECORD K1 (no KEY), STATUS FS (no FILE): each compiles and runs W=00 R=00 K001AAAA (random WRITE out of order, random READ). cite.py: OK  §1985:IX.2.3.3 SR1 (clauses after SELECT 'may appear in any order'). Refusal half: oi_c.cob (RECORD KEY, clause omitted) refused COBOL0863/COBOL1858 as sequential by default; oi_d.cob (INDEXED written twice) COBOL2423; oi_e.cob (RELATIVE KEY on indexed) COBOL0863 + COBOL0900. Reader's LINE/RECORD SEQUENTIAL refusals stand. Only cosmetic: oi_c's text says 'record sequential' (a 2023 term) at 85.
